material_news_signals.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

material_news_signals.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

material_news_signals.description: The Los Angeles Rams fell flat in their season debut, getting run over by the San Francisco 49ers in Australia.
material_news_signals.body_text: the ballyhooed los angeles rams faceplanted in australia getting blown out 27 7 by rival san francisco in a much anticipated season opener on thursday they outplayed us in every facet rams coach sean mcvay said i didn t do nearly a good enough job this is a humbling day for us this will define us only if we allow it to today was one of those days the rams took a 7 3 lead early in the second quarter on the strength of a puka nacua 41 yard catch and run from there things devolved over the next five drives the rams generated nine first downs matthew stafford tossed an int tyler higbee lost a fumble and the team turned it over on downs twice including once at the 1 yard line meanwhile a revamped defense allowed the niners to move up and down the field san francisco scored on five of its nine possessions and punted just twice both in the first half i always look inside out mcvay said i didn t do a good enough job getting us ready to go there were some opportunities where maybe the game could have flipped but they deserved the win they were ready to go and we ll look at it we ll see where we can improve and be better moving forward but this is a good humbling day this is what can sometimes happen in sports i love this locker room and you know the first thing that i m going to look at is myself and i have to do a better job for a group collectively with our coaches with our players and we ll look at this film and we ll get back to work because clearly that s obviously what we ve got to do and sometimes sports can humble you and today was one of those days much was made about the rams decision to make the 15 hour flight to melbourne late in the week while the niners spent the entire week down under whether it was the jet lag or simply a team that didn t play its starters in the preseason the rams looked sluggish most of the contest the rams scored just 7 points in their week 1 loss against the 49ers their fewest in any of the 75 games with stafford as their starter the 7 point total marks just the second stafford start for the rams with fewer than 10 points scored the other came in week 4 of 2022 at san francisco lost material_news_signals.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs pleaded no contest Thursday to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property stemming from a May altercation with his girlfriend.
material_news_signals.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs pleaded no contest thursday to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property stemming from a may altercation with his girlfriend during which she said he threw her to the ground jacobs must pay a 1 000 fine plus court costs for the battery charge under an agreement with prosecutors the criminal damage charge can be dismissed in a year if he fulfills terms that include staying out of trouble avoiding the victim in this case submitting to supervision completing counseling and paying restitution to the victim i fully understand the seriousness of the situation and i take full responsibility jacobs said during an appearance in a brown county court jacobs was arrested may 26 three days after hobart lawrence police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police the woman told them that jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head according to a criminal complaint the woman s statement was corroborated by surveillance footage from the camera system in the garage where the incident occurred jacobs was charged in late august and the nfl subsequently placed him on the commissioner s exempt list which prevents the three time pro bowl running back from playing or practicing but allows him to keep receiving a paycheck players on the commissioner s exempt list may be allowed at team facilities for meetings individual workouts therapy and rehabilitation and other non football activities we have been closely monitoring all developments in the matter which remains under review of the personal conduct policy an nfl spokesperson said in a statement there is no change to his status as he remains on the commissioner s exempt list jacobs could face a league suspension david chesnoff one of the lawyers representing jacobs said the running back already has begun counseling this plea reflects josh s acknowledgement of his actions and his acceptance of responsibility for these actions chesnoff said there are significant consequences for josh and he intends to meet all the requirements the court imposes under these negotiations jacobs entered his plea three days before the packers open the season at minnesota he is coming off a 2025 season during which he rushed for 929 yards and 13 touchdowns that followed a 2024 season in which he ran for 1 329 yards and 15 touchdowns while earning his third pro bowl selection he joined the packers in 2024 after spending his first five seasons with the raiders including a 2022 campaign in which he earned all pro honors and had an nfl leading 1 653 yards rushing the only other running backs currently on green bay s 53 man roster are marshawn lloyd chris brooks and kaleb johnson the packers acquired johnson from pittsburgh the day that jacobs was placed on the commissioner s exempt list the associated press contributed to this report

material_news_signals.description: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye threw three interceptions that led to a 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the 2026 season opener.

represent my game and playing quarterback for the patriots maye completed 23 of his 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions the bulk of his production came on short tosses and dump offs he went 20 of 23 on attempts of under 10 air yards for 134 yards and a touchdown 8 9 cpoe maye struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe all three of his picks came on deep attempts 20 air yards two more than he threw all last season 1 the three ints flipped the script as the pats watched a road only thing you could do is turn the ball over and that s what i did early maye was content to take what the defense gave him and did a far better job finding outlets versus the seahawk pressure packages than during the super bowl however late he began to hunt big plays that weren t there and got burned i just stopped being patient he said that was the big thing we were really good up to the material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
material_news_signals.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
material_news_signals.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

material_news_signals.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

material_news_signals.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs pleaded no contest thursday to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property stemming from a may altercation with his girlfriend during which she said he threw her to the ground jacobs must pay a 1 000 fine plus court costs for the battery charge under an agreement with prosecutors the criminal damage charge can be dismissed in a year if he fulfills terms that include staying out of trouble avoiding the victim in this case submitting to supervision completing counseling and paying restitution to the victim i fully understand the seriousness of the situation and i take full responsibility jacobs said during an appearance in a brown county court jacobs was arrested may 26 three days after hobart lawrence police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police the woman told them that jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head according to a criminal complaint the woman s statement was corroborated by surveillance footage from the camera system in the garage where the incident occurred jacobs was charged in late august and the nfl subsequently placed him on the commissioner s exempt list which prevents the three time pro bowl running back from playing or practicing but allows him to keep receiving a paycheck players on the commissioner s exempt list may be allowed at team facilities for meetings individual workouts therapy and rehabilitation and other non football activities we have been closely monitoring all developments in the matter which remains under review of the personal conduct policy an nfl spokesperson said in a statement there is no change to his status as he remains on the commissioner s exempt list jacobs could face a league suspension david chesnoff one of the lawyers representing jacobs said the running back already has begun counseling this plea reflects josh s acknowledgement of his actions and his acceptance of responsibility for these actions chesnoff said there are significant consequences for josh and he intends to meet all the requirements the court imposes under these negotiations jacobs entered his plea three days before the packers open the season at minnesota he is coming off a 2025 season during which he rushed for 929 yards and 13 touchdowns that followed a 2024 season in which he ran for 1 329 yards and 15 touchdowns while earning his third pro bowl selection he joined the packers in 2024 after spending his first five seasons with the raiders including a 2022 campaign in which he earned all pro honors and had an nfl leading 1 653 yards rushing the only other running backs currently on green bay s 53 man roster are marshawn lloyd chris brooks and kaleb johnson the packers acquired johnson from pittsburgh the day that jacobs was placed on the commissioner s exempt list the associated press contributed to this report
